permit.applies: The worker, or an authorised person on the worker's behalf (a travel agent, a cruise ship operator, a family member), through the online portal.
permit.first: Details of the contract or other arrangement under which the work will be done, and the health insurance the Ordinance requires.

sources.title: Government of South Georgia & the South Sandwich Islands, Entry Control Ordinance: Permit Application
sources.said: Applications can be made by an individual, or multiple applications can be made on behalf of a number of persons by an authorised person such as travel agent, cruise ship operator or a family member. … Applications should be received and paid for at least 8 days prior to the 1st intended date of arrival (disembarkation) in the Territories. … A work permit is valid for 6 months. Both visitor and work permits can be extended, where justified, for a period of an additional 30 days for visitors and 6 months for a work permit, respectively. … Applications for permits for work only – Details of the contract or other arrangement under which the applicant proposes to work in the Territories … Work Permits – No charge for a 6-month permit.

sources.title: Entry Control Ordinance 2022 (SGSSI Ordinance No. 2 of 2022)
sources.said: in the case of a permit for work, 12 months from the expected date of the permit holder first entering the Territories or the period required to perform the contract or other agreement under which the work is to be done, whichever is the shorter … in the case of a permit for work, by up to 6 months

sources.title: SGSSI Gazette No. 4 (2025), Notice of fee for applications for permit for visit or work
sources.said: with effect from 1 August 2025, the fee for an application for:- (a) a visitor permit is £200; and (b) a work permit is £0 (nil)

note: The Entry Control Ordinance 2022 (in force 1 August 2025) lets a work permit run up to 12 months or the contract's length, whichever is shorter, and be extended by up to 6 months; the Government's page says a work permit is valid for 6 months and extendable by 6. The page's 6 months is held as what is granted. The work permit is free (Gazette notice of 22 July 2025). The Government states no decision time, only that applications must be in and paid at least 8 days before arrival, and none made 3 days or less before arrival is approved.
